title: Uptime monitors
empty: No monitors yet. Add one to watch a URL, a TCP port, a cron job or a certificate.

form.graceHint: Extra wait after the interval before the job counts as late. Blank uses the server default.
form.daysHint: Degraded under the warning days, down under the critical days. Blank uses the server default.
form.pingHint: Shown once. Append /start before the job and /fail on error. Rotate it with the CLI if it leaks.
form.name: Name
form.statusLinkHint: Opens an incident on the linked status component while this monitor is down and resolves it after recovery. Off by default.

delete.title: Delete monitor {{name}}?
delete.description: Its results and rollups are deleted with it.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.empty: No incidents. Confirmed monitor outages and promoted alerts show up here.

publish.confirmTitle: Publish to the public status page?
publish.confirmBody: This becomes public immediately and cannot be unpublished. Check the text below.
publish.already: Published. Post further public updates from the status page settings.
publish.stale: This incident changed since you loaded it. Refresh and review the draft again.
publish.changed: The draft changed while you were publishing. Nothing was published; review it again.
